## Pricing & booking terms (from https://www.sushitravels.com/terms-and-conditions)
- Outstation billing: minimum 250 km or 300 km per calendar day depending on vehicle category; standard duty 6:00 AM–10:00 PM for vehicles with a published rate.
- Driver bata (daily allowance) varies by vehicle and by route; the per-day figure for each vehicle is listed above and your quote confirms the exact amount. Night driving between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM adds a night allowance.
- Tolls (FASTag), parking, interstate permits and entry fees are paid at actuals.
- GST: 5% on commercial passenger transport invoices.
- Cancellation: more than 24 hours before departure — 100% advance refunded; 12–24 hours — 50%; under 12 hours or no-show — advance retained.
- Fuel, vehicle insurance and routine maintenance are covered by Sushi Travels; no surge pricing is applied for peak hours, festivals or high-demand dates.
- Airport pickups include a complimentary 45-minute wait for flight delays, with flight tracking on request.
- Punctuality is guaranteed: your chauffeur arrives at the confirmed pickup time.
- Chauffeurs are police-verified and have a minimum of 5 years of commercial highway and mountain-ghat driving experience.
- Vehicles marked "Price on Request" have no fixed per-km rate; call or WhatsApp with your route, dates and group size for a quote.

### 25 Seater Mini Bus for Rent in Bangalore
- Bangalore – Mysuru – Bangalore (same day): ₹13,000 – ₹16,000 (~286 km, 300 km/day minimum)
- Bangalore – Ooty – Bangalore (2 days / 1 night): ₹27,000 – ₹33,000 (~540 km, 2 × 300 km/day minimum)
Indicative estimates only, not a fixed tariff. They assume the day-minimum kilometres above, driver bata, and typical tolls (plus state permit and entry charges on the Ooty trip). Parking, night halt and any extra stops are additional. The final quote depends on your date, pickup point and itinerary — call or WhatsApp for an exact price.

## Questions and answers: vehicles
### Sedan Rental in Bangalore with Driver
Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/vehicles/sedan-rental-bangalore
Q: What is the per-km rate for sedan rental in Bangalore?
A: Both the Toyota Etios and Maruti Suzuki Dzire are priced at ₹13/km, with a 300 km/day minimum billing distance. This is the confirmed rate for both sedans in our fleet — there is no separate "starting from" figure.

Q: Is driver bata included in the sedan rate?
A: Driver bata (₹400/day) is charged separately from the per-km rate, along with tolls, parking, permits and state taxes at actuals. Standard duty hours are 6:00 AM–10:00 PM; driving after 10:00 PM attracts extra driver bata.

Q: Can I book a sedan for outstation travel?
A: Yes. The Etios and Dzire are both used for outstation round trips to nearby destinations such as Mysore and Tirupati, subject to the 300 km/day minimum billing. For longer or larger-group outstation trips, an SUV or Tempo Traveller is usually more comfortable.

Q: Can I book airport pickup with a sedan?
A: Yes, sedan airport pickup and drop is one of the most common bookings we take — both cars are well suited to solo travellers, couples, and small families with standard luggage.

Q: Can I book the Innova for outstation travel?

### 12-Seater Tempo Traveller Rental in Bangalore
Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/vehicles/tempo-traveller-rental-bangalore
Q: What is the per-km rate for the Tempo Traveller?
A: The AC Tempo Traveller is ₹22/km and the Non-AC Tempo Traveller is ₹20/km, both with a 300 km/day minimum billing distance.

Q: Is driver bata included?
A: Driver bata is ₹700/day for both tiers, billed separately from the per-km rate. Tolls, parking, permits and state taxes are additional. Standard duty is 6:00 AM–10:00 PM, with extra bata after 10:00 PM.

Q: Can I book this for outstation travel?
A: Yes — the Tempo Traveller is our most-booked vehicle for outstation group trips such as Coorg, Ooty and Mysore, comfortably seating up to 12 with luggage.

Q: Can I book airport pickup with this vehicle?
A: Yes, group airport pickup/drop is available — useful when a family or group is arriving together and wants to travel from the airport in one vehicle.

Q: Which Tempo Traveller size should I choose?
A: We run three Tempo Traveller sizes: 9-seater (executive seating, ₹28/km), 12-seater (AC/Non-AC, ₹20–22/km), and 17-seater (AC/Non-AC, ₹28–30/km). For 12–16 passengers or a more premium cabin, the Force Urbania range is also worth comparing — see the table above.

Q: What is the difference between AC and Non-AC?
A: Both run the same pushback seating, luggage boot, USB points and music system. AC adds dual roof-mounted cooling across every row, better suited to summer travel and longer routes; Non-AC is a practical option for shorter or cooler-weather trips at a slightly lower per-km rate.

Q: Do you provide a driver with the Tempo Traveller?
A: Yes — every Tempo Traveller booking includes a verified chauffeur. Self-drive is not offered.

## Questions and answers: services
### Bangalore Airport Taxi Service
Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/services/bangalore-airport-taxi
Q: Which vehicle should I book for airport pickup?
A: A sedan works well for one or two passengers with standard luggage. Families of five or more, or anyone with extra bags, are usually better off with an Innova or Innova Crysta. Groups of eight or more should book a Tempo Traveller or Force Urbania.

Q: Do you track flight delays for pickup?
A: Yes — share your flight number when booking and our dispatch team will adjust the pickup timing for early or delayed landings on request.

Q: Are tolls included in the airport taxi fare?
A: No, tolls, parking and permit charges are additional and billed at actuals, in line with our standard rental terms across the fleet.

Q: Can I book a one-way airport drop only?
A: Yes, one-way airport drop and pickup are both available — you don't need to book a round trip for an airport transfer.

Q: Is airport pickup punctuality guaranteed?
A: Yes — we guarantee punctuality: your chauffeur arrives at the confirmed pickup time, and for airport arrivals we track your flight on request so the driver is waiting when you land.

Q: Is there a waiting time allowance for delayed flights?
A: Yes — airport pickups include a complimentary 45-minute wait for flight delays, and we track your flight on request so the driver is there when you land.

Q: Does airport taxi pricing go up at peak times?
A: No — we do not apply surge pricing. The fare you are quoted is the fare you pay, plus tolls and parking at actuals.

Q: How long does it take to reach Bangalore airport by taxi?
A: The airport is roughly 35–40 km from central Bangalore. Plan on about an hour in light traffic and longer during weekday peak hours, so leave extra buffer when you are catching a flight.

Q: What is the airport taxi fare in Bangalore?
A: The fare depends on the vehicle, your pickup or drop area, and the time of day, with tolls and parking billed at actuals. Call or WhatsApp us with your address and flight time for a confirmed fare before you travel.

Q: Do you serve both airport terminals?
A: Yes — tell us your terminal and airline when booking, along with your flight number, and your driver will be briefed for the right pickup point.

### Outstation Cab Service from Bangalore
Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/services/outstation-cab-bangalore
Q: Is outstation pricing per km or a fixed package?

Q: Do you offer one-way outstation trips or only round trips?
A: We primarily operate round-trip outstation bookings, though one-way and multi-day itineraries can be arranged — mention your exact plan when enquiring.

Q: Which vehicle is best for hill-station routes like Coorg or Ooty?
A: An SUV (Innova/Innova Crysta) suits smaller families, while a Tempo Traveller or Force Urbania is more comfortable for groups of 8 or more on longer ghat-road drives.

Q: Are driver food and lodging charged separately?
A: No — driver food and lodging are included within the outstation per-km rate. Only driver bata, tolls, parking, permits and state taxes are additional.

Q: Can I do a same-day round trip to Mysore?
A: Yes — Mysore is one of the most common same-day round trips we run from Bangalore, comfortably doable within a single day.

A: Exact route fares depend on the vehicle chosen, trip duration and applicable tolls/permits — call or WhatsApp us with your travel date and group size for an accurate quote.

Q: Which vehicle is best for a Mysore day trip?
A: A sedan or Innova suits smaller families; for larger groups, a Tempo Traveller keeps everyone together and is one of our most-booked options for this route.

Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-hampi-cab
Q: What is the distance from Bangalore to Hampi?
A: The Bangalore to Hampi route is approximately 340 km one way, taking roughly 6–7 hours by road.

Q: Can I do a same-day trip to Hampi?
A: It's possible but not recommended given the distance — we suggest a 2-day/1-night overnight round trip to comfortably see the ruins.

Q: What is the fare for a Bangalore to Hampi cab?
A: Fares depend on vehicle type and trip duration — call or WhatsApp us with your dates and group size for an accurate quote.

Q: Can I book a bus for a large Hampi tour group?
A: Yes — our 25-seater and 50-seater bus tiers are available on a per-trip quote for larger heritage tour groups or school/college trips.

### Bangalore to Tirupati Cab Service
Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-tirupati-cab
Q: What is the distance from Bangalore to Tirupati?
A: The Bangalore to Tirupati route is approximately 250 km one way, taking roughly 5–5.5 hours by road.

Q: Can I do a same-day Tirupati darshan trip?
A: Yes — an early-morning departure with a waiting driver in Tirupati is our standard arrangement for same-day return pilgrimage trips.

Q: What is the fare for a Bangalore to Tirupati cab?
A: Fares depend on vehicle type and whether it's a same-day or overnight trip — call or WhatsApp us with your dates and group size for an accurate quote.

Q: Which vehicle suits an extended-family pilgrimage trip?
A: A sedan or SUV works for a small family; for extended families travelling together, our Tempo Traveller tiers are a popular choice.

### Bangalore to Pondicherry Cab Service
Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-pondicherry-cab
Q: What is the distance from Bangalore to Pondicherry?
A: The Bangalore to Pondicherry route is approximately 310 km one way, taking roughly 6–7 hours by road.

Q: Is Pondicherry a good weekend trip from Bangalore?
A: Yes, it's a popular 2-day/1-night weekend getaway for couples and friend groups given the mostly highway drive.

Q: What is the fare for a Bangalore to Pondicherry cab?
A: Fares depend on vehicle type and trip duration — call or WhatsApp us with your dates and group size for an accurate quote.

Q: Which vehicle suits a Pondicherry weekend trip?
A: A sedan or SUV is comfortable for couples and small groups; a Tempo Traveller works well for larger friend circles travelling together.

### Bangalore to Chennai Cab Service
Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-chennai-cab
Q: What is the distance from Bangalore to Chennai?
A: The Bangalore to Chennai route is approximately 350 km one way, taking roughly 6–6.5 hours by road via NH44.

Q: Can I book a one-way drop to Chennai?
A: Yes, one-way drops are available on this route in addition to round trips — mention your requirement when enquiring.

Q: What is the fare for a Bangalore to Chennai cab?
A: Fares depend on vehicle type and whether it's one-way or round trip — call or WhatsApp us with your dates for an accurate quote.

Q: Which vehicle suits a Bangalore to Chennai business trip?
A: A sedan is a practical, economical choice for a single business traveller; families or those with more luggage often prefer an Innova.

### Bangalore to Hyderabad Cab Service
Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-hyderabad-cab
Q: What is the distance from Bangalore to Hyderabad?
A: The Bangalore to Hyderabad route is approximately 570 km one way, taking roughly 9–10 hours by road.

Q: Is this a one-day drive?
A: It can be done in a single long day, though some travellers prefer to break the journey — this can be arranged as part of your itinerary.

Q: What is the fare for a Bangalore to Hyderabad cab?
A: Fares depend on vehicle type and whether it's one-way or round trip — call or WhatsApp us with your dates for an accurate quote.

Q: Which vehicle is recommended for this route?
A: Given the distance, an SUV like the Innova or Innova Crysta is recommended over a sedan for extra comfort; larger groups can book a Tempo Traveller.

### Bangalore to Mangalore Cab Service
Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/routes/bangalore-to-mangalore-cab
Q: What is the distance from Bangalore to Mangalore?
A: The Bangalore to Mangalore route is approximately 350 km one way, taking roughly 7–8 hours by road via the Western Ghats.

Q: Does this route cross the Western Ghats?
A: Yes, the drive crosses the Western Ghats before descending to the coast, which is why travel time runs a bit longer than the distance alone would suggest.

Q: What is the fare for a Bangalore to Mangalore cab?
A: Fares depend on vehicle type and whether it's one-way or round trip — call or WhatsApp us with your dates for an accurate quote.

Q: Which vehicle suits the Western Ghats crossing?
A: An SUV like the Innova or Innova Crysta is recommended for the ghat-road sections; larger groups can book a Tempo Traveller.

A: Yes — airport pickup and drop from Whitefield is one of our regular bookings, with flight-time coordination available on request.

Q: Is outstation booking available from Whitefield?
A: Yes, outstation round trips to destinations like Mysore, Coorg and Ooty can be booked with pickup from Whitefield.

### Car Rental in Electronic City, Bangalore
Source: https://www.sushitravels.com/locations/car-rental-electronic-city

A: Yes, we serve Electronic City for local pickup/drop, corporate travel, airport transfers and outstation bookings.

Q: How far is the airport from Electronic City?
A: Electronic City is on the southern side of Bangalore, generally further from Kempegowda Airport than central or northern areas — we recommend booking with extra buffer time for airport pickups from here.

Q: Can I book an outstation trip toward Mysore from Electronic City?
A: Yes — and being on the southern side of the city, Electronic City pickups can have a slight head start on southern outstation routes like Mysore compared to northern parts of Bangalore.
